name: Western N. America heat dome
headline: Clear skies, sinking air; LA extreme heat warning.

sections.The trigger: Clear skies, sinking air; LA extreme heat warning.
sections.What amplified it: 11–17 °C above normal; Phoenix about 40.6 °C (105 °F) observed (CNN) against the previous March record of 37.8 °C (100 °F) (WWA).
sections.Climate signal: Virtually impossible without warming; ~800× more likely (WWA, as reported by AP).
sections.Still open: Summary entry: the full deep-dive (day-by-day timeline, steering, how it ended, sources) has not been written yet. It will be added as the log works back through the year.
